textes.Alex, Lolo et leurs invité·e·s ont analy: Alex, Lolo and their guests reviewed
textes.Une plongée exigeante dans la BD, portée: A demanding dive into comics, carried by genuinely good writing — a niche owned all the way.
textes.La zététique en podcast, méthodique et n: Scientific skepticism as a podcast, methodical and necessary — an authority built episode after episode.
textes.Des histoires vraies transformées en réc: True stories turned into near-cinematic narratives — it hooks you from the first minute.
textes.Trois minutes chaque samedi qui donnent: Three minutes every Saturday that make you want to listen to things you'd never have found on your own.
textes.L'actu économique analysée avec rigueur: Business news analysed with rigour and clarity — understanding without jargon, every day.
textes.La culture populaire décortiquée avec in: Pop culture dissected with intelligence, from blockbusters to Victor Hugo — brilliant.
textes.La tech remise en contexte avec rigueur: Tech put back in context with rigour and balance, far from just relaying announcements.
textes.Les neurosciences vulgarisées avec série: Neuroscience explained seriously and accessibly — finally understanding your own brain.
textes.Le podcast qui prend le jeu vidéo au sér: The podcast that takes video games seriously: meaning, history, cultural impact. A benchmark.
textes.De l'humour sincère et générationnel enr: Sincere, generational humour recorded on a shoestring — and the charm works.
textes.Immersif, intime, troublant de justesse: Immersive, intimate, unsettlingly accurate: real introspection in a few dozen minutes.
textes.L'endurance racontée par ceux qui la viv: Endurance told by those who live it — a solid date for anyone who loves a good effort.
textes.L'Histoire racontée comme une fiction, d: History told like fiction, from Churchill to Solitude — gripping from start to finish.
textes.La référence absolue du jeu indé francop: The absolute reference for indie games in French: passionate scouting nobody else does.
textes.Une rénovation documentée avec sincérité: A renovation documented with sincerity and method — the personal project inspiring thousands of DIYers.
textes.La chaîne fondatrice de la vulgarisation: The founding channel of manga explainers in France — a huge contribution to French-language culture.
textes.Le true crime sans sensationnalisme : ri: True crime without sensationalism: rigorous, respectful, addictive.
textes.La cuisine replacée dans l'histoire et l: Food put back into history and society — Gaudry's gourmet erudition hits the mark.
textes.Le contrepoint critique à la mythologie: The critical counterpoint to Silicon Valley mythology: personal, consistent, necessary.
textes.Le dépassement de soi sans stats ni tact: Pushing your limits without stats or tactics: just the mindset of extreme athletes.
textes.Le pionnier du débat sportif français :: The pioneer of French sports talk: a whole school of journalism… excesses included.
textes.Monument de la vulgarisation historique: A monument of popular history: serious without being stuffy, original without trying too hard.
textes.Un OVNI à la croisée de l'animation, du: An oddity at the crossroads of animation, dubbing and parody — unique and skilfully done.
textes.Des arguments solides pour comprendre po: Solid arguments for understanding why overly simple legends are wrong — refreshing.
textes.Le doudou générationnel du gaming frança: The generational comfort blanket of French gaming: a channel that grew up with its community without selling out.
textes.L'Histoire pour enfants si bien racontée: History for kids, told so well you end up jealous of the kids.
textes.Le podcast dev préféré de ceux qui juren: The favourite dev podcast of people who swear they no longer have time for podcasts.
textes.Le podcast zombie par excellence : termi: The ultimate zombie podcast: finished, yet immortal — like the B-movies it reviewed.
textes.Sur 50 formats, la qualité est inégale —: Across 50 formats the quality is uneven — but Step Back, Big 5 and L'Avenir leur appartient are excellent.
textes.Une voix, une histoire : Dussollier tran: One voice, one story: Dussollier turns radio storytelling into a confidence. Masterful.
textes.Un journal de création en direct, drôle: A live creative diary, funny and clear-eyed — total improvisation as a public high-wire act.
textes.Amateur dans la production, expert dans: Amateur production, expert substance: the organised passion of a real community.
textes.Pertinent, clivant, mystérieux — le fant: Sharp, divisive, mysterious — the most consistent ghost on gaming YouTube.
textes.Baffie en grand interviewer : l'humour s: Baffie as a great interviewer: humour without overdoing it, and real moments of emotion.
textes.Du comique en temps réel, imprévisible e: Real-time comedy, unpredictable and baroque — the post-match bar we'd always dreamed of.
textes.La référence NBA francophone : une tribu: The French-language NBA reference: a tribe that fills the Grand Rex at 2 a.m.
textes.Des questions posées par quelqu'un qui c: Questions from someone who knows their subject, put to experts who master theirs — the interview that genuinely informs. Kazakhstan included.
textes.Le format immuable au service du fond :: An unchanging format in the service of substance: French tech told by the people running it, no ego and no crystal ball.
textes.L'immersion sonore poussée à son sommet: Sound immersion at its peak: you don't listen to these survival stories, you live them — and come out grateful for your sofa.
textes.Enlever tout le superflu jusqu'à ce qu'i: Strip away everything superfluous until only the essential remains — and often get the best version of the song.
textes.L'enquête journalistique appliquée à l'H: Investigative journalism applied to history: a podcast you have to earn, and you come out understanding rather than reciting.
textes.De la vulgarisation avec de la matière :: Explainers with real substance: 90 minutes that genuinely make you understand — as long as you know which version you're watching.
textes.Du savoir-faire déguisé en oisiveté : le: Craft disguised as idleness: the hardest format to pull off, held by two master craftsmen who chose to stop keeping it short.
textes.Dix-neuf ans sans se renier et une bande: Nineteen years without selling out and a crew you recognise in three seconds: they chose having taste over maximising listeners.
textes.Un podcast de marque qui ne triche pas,: A branded podcast that doesn't cheat, carried by enthusiasts — but one episode a month and a narrower scope than its title.
textes.Quarante-neuf ans, une reprise que perso: Forty-nine years, a revival nobody thought possible and France's number-one podcast: it's not survival, it's a performance.
textes.Donner envie aux jeunes de s'écouter êtr: Making young people want to listen to each other disagree: almost a public service — provided the wall between the outlet and its agencies stays very high.
textes.Un documentaire par jour depuis 2014 : l: A documentary a day since 2014: proof you can be demanding in the middle of the afternoon, in front of a huge audience.
textes.Trois ingénieurs qui n'ont rien à prouve: Three engineers with nothing to prove, finally speaking freely: number one in French-language tech within four months, and it's no accident.
textes.Dans un paysage où tout le monde comment: In a landscape where everyone comments, an outlet that stays quiet for twenty-five minutes to listen to someone: almost a political act.
textes.Jean aurait jamais marre du JeanBaptiste: You never get tired of the JeanBaptisteShow! Never the biggest or the loudest: just there, excellent, and for a long, long time. Twelve years of careful writing, harder still than a €500 gaming PC.
textes.Le GOAT du podcast business : deux heure: The GOAT of business podcasts: two hours to make the masks fall, even if it means talking about your butcher with a CAC 40 CEO.
textes.Le podcast qui a rendu l'argent discutab: The podcast that made money something you can talk about out loud. Not investment advice: a vocabulary lesson. And once you understand the vocabulary, you get fooled less.
textes.Du true crime fait par une artisane : éc: True crime by a one-woman workshop: written, narrated and produced alone, every week, with no lab to save the investigation. The crime story becomes a history lesson.
textes.L'experte qui sait de quoi elle parle —: The expert who knows what she's talking about — which sets her radically apart from the rest of the show.
textes.Passionnée de true crime et de podcasts: A fan of true crime and kids' podcasts — which says a lot about the complexity of her personality. She knows more unsolved cases than most police chiefs, and more historical figures than most adults.
textes.Le super dev qui chasse le bug comme l'i: The super dev who hunts bugs like he hunts injustice — and whose tech skills are as good as his talent as a guest on the channel.
textes.Le flegme fait homme : pendant que toute: Composure in human form: while the whole NBA goes wild over a buzzer-beater, Jael raises an eyebrow — tops. A calm that bounces better than a basketball. Dare you?
textes.Qui sommes-nous — MediaCritic, le podcas: About us — MediaCritic, the French-language podcast
textes.Les meilleurs podcasts business et entre: The best French-language business and entrepreneurship podcasts
textes.Entrepreneuriat, finance, stratégie, éco: Entrepreneurship, finance, strategy, economics, founders' journeys… Business is one of the richest categories in French-language podcasting. Here are the go-to formats to learn, get inspired and decode the business world.
textes.Quel podcast pour entreprendre ?: Which podcast for starting a business?
textes.Les podcasts d'entrepreneuriat partagent: Entrepreneurship podcasts share the journeys, methods and lessons learned of founders and executives. This page lists the best French-language formats.
textes.Quels podcasts pour comprendre l'économi: Which podcasts help you understand the economy?
textes.Plusieurs podcasts décryptent l'actualit: Several podcasts break down economic and financial news in an accessible way. The shows reviewed by MediaCritic are flagged at the top of the page.
textes.Les meilleurs podcasts de critique ciném: The best film and TV review podcasts
textes.Critiques de films et de séries, débats: Film and TV reviews, debates on the week's releases, in-depth analysis, film history and behind-the-scenes stories… Here are the French-language film review podcasts and YouTube channels, ranked by rating and audience, with the ones MediaCritic has reviewed itself.
textes.Quel est le meilleur podcast de critique: What's the best film review podcast?
textes.Tout dépend du ton recherché. Les plus s: It depends on the tone you're after. The most followed are ranked here by Apple Podcasts rating and number of reviews; the ones MediaCritic has reviewed in detail, such as 2 Heures De Perdues or BlockBusters, carry our score out of 10 and link to our full review.
textes.Du débat critique à l'analyse de fond, l: From critical debate to in-depth analysis, French-language film podcasts cover every style: new-release reviews, genre cinema, B-movies, film history, interviews with directors. This page lists them all, with the MediaCritic badge on the ones we've reviewed.
textes.Existe-t-il des podcasts de critique de: Are there TV series review podcasts?
textes.Oui, de nombreux formats suivent l'actua: Yes, many formats follow TV news, review streaming releases and revisit the classics. They're listed on this page alongside film.
textes.Podcast ou chaîne YouTube pour la critiq: Podcast or YouTube channel for film reviews?
textes.Les deux formats sont représentés ici :: Both formats are represented here: podcasts for listening on the go, YouTube channels for analyses illustrated with footage from the films.
textes.Les meilleurs podcasts cuisine et gastro: The best French-language food and gastronomy podcasts
textes.La cuisine est la catégorie qui a le plu: Food is the category that has exploded the most on audio platforms over the past three years. Between chefs starting out, food writers thinking about what we eat and conversational podcasts around the table, there's plenty to sort through. MediaCritic has dissected Chef Otaku (technical passion) and On va déguster (the France Inter institution).
textes.Quel est le meilleur podcast pour appren: What's the best podcast for learning to cook?
textes.Pour l'apprentissage technique, les podc: For technique, chefs' podcasts like Chef Otaku are invaluable because they explain the gestures, the choices and the mistakes to avoid. For general food culture, On va déguster remains a reference — less technical, more contextual.
textes.Y a-t-il des podcasts gastronomie indépe: Are there independent food podcasts worth discovering?
textes.Oui, beaucoup. Le catalogue MediaCritic: Yes, plenty. The MediaCritic directory lists many food and gastronomy podcasts, including little-known but excellent independents.
textes.Les meilleurs podcasts culture et sociét: The best French-language culture and society podcasts
textes.Idées, débats, faits de société, philoso: Ideas, debates, social issues, philosophy, the arts… Culture and society is the broadest category in French-language podcasting. Here's a selection of formats that shed light on the world and feed the mind.
textes.Quels sont les meilleurs podcasts de soc: What are the best society podcasts?
textes.Les podcasts culture et société abordent: Culture and society podcasts tackle today's big questions with perspective and depth. This page highlights the French-language references.
textes.Commencez par les contenus analysés par: Start with the shows reviewed by MediaCritic, flagged at the top of the page, then explore the rest of the directory.
textes.Le gaming est la catégorie où l'audio et: Gaming is the category where audio and video blend the most: between long-form discussion podcasts, YouTube channels doing pure analysis and Twitch live shows re-uploaded as podcasts, there's a bit of everything — and a lot of overlap. MediaCritic has reviewed several references of the French scene.
textes.Quelle est la meilleure chaîne YouTube g: What's the best French gaming YouTube channel?
textes.Le Joueur du Grenier reste la référence: Le Joueur du Grenier remains the unrivalled reference in terms of longevity (since 2009) and audience. But for pure analysis, newer channels offer a different editorial approach.
textes.Comment MediaCritic note-t-il les podcas: How does MediaCritic rate gaming podcasts?
textes.Comme tous les autres : fond (qualité de: Like all the others: substance (quality of analysis, sources, opinions), form (editing, pace, sound), intentions (clarity of editorial positioning). YouTube formats are judged by the same criteria as audio podcasts.
textes.L'histoire est l'une des catégories les: History is one of the most crowded categories in French-language podcasting — and one of the most uneven. Between YouTube explainers moving to podcasts, professional historians trying the mic and public broadcasters producing polished series, how do you sort it out? MediaCritic has listened to and reviewed several references of the genre in detail.
textes.Quel est le meilleur podcast d'histoire: What's the best French-language history podcast for beginners?
textes.Pour s'initier, Nota Bene et Quelle Hist: To get started, Nota Bene and Quelle Histoire are accessible, well produced and explanatory without being condescending. Entrez dans l'Histoire offers a more immersive approach, and C'est plus compliqué que ça goes further into nuance for listeners already familiar with the genre.
textes.Cela dépend du créateur. Les podcasts d': It depends on the creator. Podcasts by trained historians (Nota Bene has a scientific committee, some Radio France productions work with researchers) are generally solid. Be wary of podcasts that never cite their sources.
textes.Stand-up, talk décalés, sketchs, comédie: Stand-up, offbeat talk shows, sketches, comedy… Humour is everywhere in French-language podcasts and on French YouTube. Here are the formats that make people laugh, from gleeful nonsense to sharp satire.
textes.Des talks délirants aux formats plus écr: From wild talk shows to more scripted formats, French-language comedy is very rich on podcasts and YouTube alike. This page lists the references.
textes.Histoire des genres, portraits d'artiste: Genre histories, artist portraits, song breakdowns, music news… Here are the French-language podcasts and channels for music lovers, from rap to classical by way of pop and electronic.
textes.Les podcasts musique vont du documentair: Music podcasts range from audio documentaries to fan conversations. This page lists the best French-language formats, rated and ranked.
textes.Des podcasts sur un genre musical précis: Podcasts about a specific music genre?
textes.Oui, beaucoup se spécialisent (rap, jazz: Yes, many specialise (rap, jazz, electronic, classical…). Use the full directory to narrow down by theme.
textes.Les meilleurs podcasts sciences et vulga: The best French-language science and popular science podcasts
textes.Physique, biologie, espace, climat, neur: Physics, biology, space, climate, neuroscience… French-language science communication is rich, from long educational formats to short bites. Here are the podcasts and channels that make science accessible and exciting.
textes.Les podcasts de vulgarisation scientifiq: Popular science podcasts let you understand complex subjects without a technical background. This page lists the best French-language formats, ranked and rated.
textes.Podcast ou chaîne YouTube pour la scienc: Podcast or YouTube channel for science?
textes.Les deux : certains créateurs privilégie: Both: some creators favour long-form audio, others video with diagrams and animations. MediaCritic lists and reviews both.
textes.Le podcast sport francophone, c'est enco: French-language sports podcasting is still largely about football. But formats are emerging around trail running, running, outdoor sports and broader conversations about performance and athletes' health. MediaCritic has reviewed several complementary references.
textes.Quel est le meilleur podcast football en: What's the best football podcast in French?
textes.L'After Foot (RMC) reste la référence pa: L'After Foot (RMC) remains the reference for its longevity and audience, but the radio format can feel heavy. For calmer long-form content, independent podcasts are emerging — the MediaCritic directory lists several.
textes.Y a-t-il des podcasts running ou trail à: Are there running or trail podcasts to recommend?
textes.Oui. SafePace propose un format accessib: Yes. SafePace offers an accessible running format. Extraterrien digs into ultra-endurance disciplines with in-depth athlete interviews.
textes.Le podcast tech francophone se partage e: French-language tech podcasting falls into three families: news podcasts (Le Rendez-vous Tech), opinion podcasts (Silicon Carne) and trade podcasts for developers (IFTTD, Hardisk Stories). MediaCritic has reviewed the references of each family.
textes.Quel podcast tech écouter pour rester à: Which tech podcast to stay up to date?
textes.Pour l'actualité large et grand public,: For broad, mainstream news, Le Rendez-vous Tech remains the reference. For a sharper tone and a real editorial opinion, Silicon Carne. For technical detail on the dev side, IFTTD - If This Then Dev.
textes.Non. MediaCritic est un podcast de méta-: No. MediaCritic is a meta-analysis podcast that dissects other podcasts and YouTube channels — across all categories. Tech is one of the many areas we review regularly.
textes.Les meilleurs podcasts true crime franco: The best French-language true crime podcasts
textes.Le true crime est l'un des genres les pl: True crime is one of the most listened-to genres in French-language podcasting: criminal cases, disappearances, unsolved investigations, killer profiles… Here are the reference true crime podcasts, from major journalistic formats to more intimate narratives.
textes.C'est quoi un podcast true crime ?: What is a true crime podcast?
textes.Un podcast true crime raconte des affair: A true crime podcast tells real criminal cases: murders, disappearances, judicial investigations, sometimes solved, sometimes not. The genre blends investigative journalism, immersive storytelling and analysis.
textes.Quels sont les meilleurs podcasts true c: What are the best French true crime podcasts?
textes.Parmi les références francophones, on re: Among the French-language references are formats produced by major media outlets as well as by independents. The shows reviewed by MediaCritic are highlighted at the top of this page.
textes.Récits d'aventure, carnets de route, con: Adventure stories, travel diaries, practical tips, portraits of great travellers… Travel is one of the liveliest categories in French-language podcasting, and one of the most uneven: between the home-made logbook and the finely crafted audio documentary, the gap is huge. Here are the formats that really make you want to go.
textes.Quel podcast de voyage écouter avant de: Which travel podcast to listen to before you leave?
textes.Selon ce que vous cherchez : les podcast: It depends on what you're after: storytelling podcasts tell an adventure from start to finish, practical formats help you plan a specific itinerary. This page lists both families, rated and ranked.
textes.Beaucoup se consacrent à une région ou à: Many focus on a region or a type of trip (hiking, round-the-world, family travel…). The full directory lets you narrow it down.
textes.c'était il y a quelques jours: it was a few days ago
textes.C'est l'émission du nouvel épisode de Me: It's the show featured in MediaCritic's new episode, out this morning
textes.Pas de donnée sur ce point : essaie au f: No data on this one: go with your gut!
